description: 1n 1959 eleven Mau Mau freedom fighters were clubbed to death by guards at Hola detention camp. The incident became ínternationally known as the Hola Massacre'. This statue honours these eleven men. It was unveiled in 1998 by Hon. S.K. Msyoka, at that time Minister of Education
